description: Synthetic fictional company policy; labels authored for this exploratory evaluation, not human-validated or representative.

documents.text: Aster shop accepts return requests within 30 calendar days after delivery. Products must be unused. Refunds are sent to the original payment method.
Aster employees must attach an itemized receipt when submitting a business expense reimbursement request. Submit the request through the employee portal.
Aster account access requires multi-factor authentication. Employees must report a suspected phishing message to security@example.test without clicking its links.
Aster employees receive 20 paid vacation days per year. Unused vacation can carry forward up to five days to the next year.
Aster standard shipping takes three to five business days after dispatch. Express shipping takes one to two business days.
Aster retains application access logs for 90 days. Access to logs is restricted to authorized security staff.

queries.question: How long after delivery can a customer return an unused product?
queries.reference_answer: Within 30 calendar days after delivery, for unused products.
